parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   **zh-CN**: Chinese
*   **en-US** (default): English

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the health check template that you want to query. This ID uniquely identifies the health check template.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-cloud-gtm-monitor-template --accept-language zh-CN --template-id mtp-895180524251000000 --region cn-hangzhou
